title: Pad Kra Pao Moo (Thai Basil Pork Rice)
summary: A punchy Thai rice dish of minced pork stir-fried with garlic, chilies, basil, and savory sauce, finished with a fried egg.

steps.description: Finely chop 4 garlic cloves and 2 Thai chilies. Rinse and dry 20g holy basil. In a small bowl, mix 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sugar, and 2 tbsp water.
Heat 1 tbsp neutral oil in a pan and fry 2 eggs until the edges are crisp. Transfer to a plate.

Add the remaining 1 tbsp neutral oil to the pan, stir-fry the garlic and chilies for 20 seconds, then add 300g ground pork. Break it up and cook 4–5 minutes until fully cooked (at least 71°C internally).
Pour in the sauce and stir-fry for 1–2 minutes until it coats the pork. Add the 20g basil just before turning off the heat and toss for 20–30 seconds until wilted.
Divide the 2 bowls of warm rice between plates, top each with half the basil pork, and finish each with 1 fried egg. Serve hot.
